english: Use one measuring cup of the liquid.
amharic_ref: አንድ የፈሳሹን መለኪያ ኩባያ ይጠቀሙ።
oromo_ref: Dhangala'aa kanaa kubbaayyaa safartuu tokko fayyadami.

english: Mix one tablespoon of the powder into a cup of water.
amharic_ref: አንድ የሾርባ ማንኪያ ዱቄት ከውሃ ኩባያ ጋር ይቀላቅሉ።
oromo_ref: Daakuu kana fal'aana guddaa tokko bishaan kubbaayyaa tokko keessatti bulbuli.

english: Use three drops in each ear.
amharic_ref: በእያንዳንዱ ጆሮ ላይ ሶስት ጠብታዎች ይጠቀሙ።
oromo_ref: Gurra tokko tokkotti coboo sadii cobsi.

english: Apply a pea-sized amount of the ointment.
amharic_ref: ቅባቱን በአተር ትልቀት መጠን ይቀቡ።
oromo_ref: Dibata kana hanga ija ataraa gahu dibi.

english: Give the child one 5 ml spoonful of the medicine.
amharic_ref: ለልጆ ከመድሃኒቱ አንድ 5ሚሊ ሙሉ ማንኪያ ይስጡት።
oromo_ref: Qoricha kana fal'aana mililiitira 5 guutuu tokko daa'imichaaf kenni.

english: Take one chewable tablet.
amharic_ref: አንድ የሚታኘክ ኪኒን ይውሰዱ።
oromo_ref: Kiniinii alanfatamu tokko fudhadhu.

english: Use two sprays in each nostril.
amharic_ref: እያንዳንዱን የአፍንጫ ቀዳዳ ሁለት ጊዜ ይርጩት።
oromo_ref: Qaawwa funyaanii tokko tokkotti al lama biifi.

english: Stir three spoonfuls of the powder into warm water.
amharic_ref: ከዱቄቱ ሶስት ሙሉ ማንኪያ ከሙቅ ወሃ ጋር ያማስሉ።
oromo_ref: Daakuu kana fal'aana sadii bishaan ho'aa keessatti bulbuli.

english: Take 15 ml of the syrup.
amharic_ref: ከሽሮፑ 15 ሚሊ ይውሰዱ።
oromo_ref: Siirappii kana mililiitira 15 fudhadhu.

english: Take three capsules.
amharic_ref: ሶስት ካፕሱሎች ይውሰዱ።
oromo_ref: Kaapsulii sadii fudhadhu.

english: Use a small amount of gel, about the size of a coin.
amharic_ref: ትንሽ ጄል ይጠቀሙ፤ በሳንቲም ትልቀት መጠን።
oromo_ref: Jeelii kana xiqqoo, hanga saantimaa gahu fayyadami.

english: Take half a teaspoon of the powder.
amharic_ref: ከዱቄቱ ግማሽ የሻይ ማንኪያ ይውሰዱ።
oromo_ref: Daakuu kana fal'aana shaayii walakkaa fudhadhu.

english: Give your child one sachet.
amharic_ref: ለልጆ አንድ እሽግ ይስጡት።
oromo_ref: Daa'ima keetiif paakeettii tokko kenni.

english: Put 20 drops in a little water.
amharic_ref: በትንሽ ውሃ ውስጥ 20 ጠብታ ያድርጉ።
oromo_ref: Bishaan xiqqoo keessatti coboo 20 cobsi.

english: Use the eye drops every 3 hours while you are awake.
amharic_ref: ባልተኙ ጊዜ የአይን ጠብታውን በየ3 ሰዓታት ይጠቀሙ።
oromo_ref: Yeroo dammaqaa jirtutti sa'aatii 3 3n coboo ijaa fayyadami.

english: Take two capsules in the evening for four days.
amharic_ref: በምሽት ሁለት ካፕሱሎች ለአራት ቀናት ይውሰዱ።
oromo_ref: Guyyaa afuriif galgala galgala kaapsulii lama fudhadhu.

english: Take the syrup three times a day for one week.
amharic_ref: ሽሮፑን በቀን ሶስት ጊዜ ለአንድ ሳምንት ይውሰዱ።
oromo_ref: Torban tokkoof guyyaatti si'a sadii siirappii kana fudhadhu.

english: Take one dose every morning for 21 days.
amharic_ref: በጠዋት አንድ ዶዝ  ለ21 ቀናት ይውሰዱ።
oromo_ref: Guyyaa 21f ganama ganama safartuu tokko fudhadhu.

english: Take one tablet each evening for two months.
amharic_ref: ሁልጊዜ ማታ አንድ ኪኒን ለ21 ቀናት ይውሰዱ።
oromo_ref: Ji'a lamaaf galgala galgala kiniinii tokko fudhadhu.

english: Do not use this ointment near your eyes.
amharic_ref: ይህን ቅባት ጆሮዎ አካባቢ እንዳይጠቀሙ።
oromo_ref: Dibata kana naannoo ija keetiitti hin fayyadamin.

english: Do not take this medicine with grapefruit juice.
amharic_ref: ይህን መድሃኒት ከቆምጣጤ ጭማቂ ጋር እንዳይወስዱት።
oromo_ref: Qoricha kana cuunfaa gireeppiifiruutii waliin hin fudhatin.

english: Do not give this medicine to a baby under 6 months.
amharic_ref: ከ6 ወር በታች ለሆኑ ህጻናት ይህን መድሃኒት እንዳይሰጡ።
oromo_ref: Daa'ima ji'a 6 gadi ta'eef qoricha kana hin kennin.

english: Do not open the capsule.
amharic_ref: ካፕሱሉን እንዳይከፍቱት።
oromo_ref: Kaapsulii sana hin banin.

english: Do not use the eye drops while wearing contact lenses.
amharic_ref: የአይን ኮንታክት ምስሪት አድርገው የአይን ጠብታዎቹን እንዳይጠቀሙ።
oromo_ref: Yeroo leensii ijaa kaawwattee jirtutti coboo ijaa hin fayyadamin.

english: Do not take this medicine if you have a stomach ulcer.
amharic_ref: የጨጓራ ቁስለት ካለቦት ይህን መድሃኒት እንዳይወስዱ።
oromo_ref: Yoo madaa garaachaa qabaatte qoricha kana hin fudhatin.

english: Do not use this spray near a flame.
amharic_ref: ይህን መርጫ እሳት አካባቢ እንዳይጠቀሙት።
oromo_ref: Biiftuu kana naannoo ibiddaatti hin fayyadamin.

english: Do not touch your eye with the tip of the bottle.
amharic_ref: በጠርሙዙ ጫፍ አይኖትን እንዳይነኩ።
oromo_ref: Fiixee qaruuraa sanaan ija kee hin tuqin.

english: Do not take extra doses if your symptoms get worse.
amharic_ref: ምልክቶቹ ከባሱ ተጨማሪ ዶዞች እንዳይወስዱ።
oromo_ref: Yoo mallattoon dhukkubaa sitti hammaate safartuu dabalataa hin fudhatin.

english: Do not use this medicine if the liquid has changed color.
amharic_ref: የፈሳሹ ቀለም ከተቀየረ መድሃኒቱን እንዳይጠቀሙ።
oromo_ref: Yoo dhangala'aan sun bifa jijjiirrate qoricha kana hin fayyadamin.

english: Do not swallow this ointment.
amharic_ref: ይህን ቅባት እንዳይውጡ።
oromo_ref: Dibata kana hin liqimsin.

english: Do not take more than one dose of this medicine each day.
amharic_ref: ከዚህ መድሃኒት በየቀኑ ከአንድ ዶዝ በላይ እንዳይወስዱ።
oromo_ref: Guyyaa tokkotti qoricha kana safartuu tokkoo ol hin fudhatin.

english: Avoid tea and coffee for an hour after taking this medicine.
amharic_ref: ይህን መድሃኒት ከወሰዱ በኋላ ለአንድ ሰዓት ከሻይ እና ከቡና ይጠንቀቁ።
oromo_ref: Qoricha kana erga fudhattee booda sa'aatii tokkoof shaayii fi buna hin dhugin.

english: Do not mix this medicine with other medicines unless a doctor says so.
amharic_ref: ሃኪም እስካላሎት ድረስ ይህን መድሃኒት ከሌሎች መድሃኒቶች ጋር እንዳይቀላቅሉ።
oromo_ref: Hakiimni yoo siin jedhe malee qoricha kana qorichoota biroo waliin walitti hin makin.

english: Do not lie down for 30 minutes after taking this tablet.
amharic_ref: ይህን ኪኒን ከወሰዱ በኋላ ለ30 ደቂቃዎች ጋደም እንዳይሉ።
oromo_ref: Kiniinii kana erga fudhattee booda daqiiqaa 30f hin ciisin.

english: Do not use this inhaler more than four times a day.
amharic_ref: ይህን መተንፈሻ በቀን ከአራት ጊዜ በላይ እንዳይጠቀሙ።
oromo_ref: Inheelarii kana guyyaatti si'a afurii ol hin fayyadamin.

english: Do not give aspirin to a child under 12.
amharic_ref: ከ12 ዓመት በታች ለሆኑ ልጆች አስፕሪን እንዳይሰጡ።
oromo_ref: Ijoollee waggaa 12 gadi ta'aniif aspiiriinii hin kennin.

english: Do not double the dose if you vomit after taking it.
amharic_ref: ከወሰዱት በኋላ ካስመለሶት ዶዙን እጥፍ እንዳያደርጉ።
oromo_ref: Erga fudhattee booda yoo si haqqisiise safartuu dachaa hin fudhatin.

english: Avoid direct sunlight while using this cream.
amharic_ref: ይህን ክሬም በሚጠቀሙበት ጊዜ በቀጥታ ከሚመጣ የጸሃይ ብርሃን ይጠንቀቁ።
oromo_ref: Yeroo kiriimii kana fayyadamtu aduun kallattiin akka si hin argine of eeggadhu.

english: Never give this medicine to a child without asking a doctor.
amharic_ref: ሃኪም ሳይጠይቁ ይህን መድሃኒት ለልጅ እንዳይሰጡ።
oromo_ref: Hakiima osoo hin gaafatin gonkumaa qoricha kana daa'imaaf hin kennin.

english: Place the patch on clean, dry skin.
amharic_ref: ፓቹን ንጹህ እና ደረቅ ቆዳ ላይ ይለጥፉት።
oromo_ref: Laastika qorichaa sana gogaa qulqulluu fi gogaa ta'e irra kaa'i.

english: Let the tablet melt on your tongue.
amharic_ref: ኪኒኑ ምላሶ ላይ እንዲቀልጥ ያድርጉ።
oromo_ref: Kiniiniin sun arraba kee irratti akka baqu godhi.

english: This spray is for use in the nose only.
amharic_ref: ይህ መርጫ ለአፍንጫ ጥቅም ብቻ ነው።
oromo_ref: Biiftuun kun funyaan keessatti qofa kan fayyadamuudha.

english: Take this medicine when you wake up, before you eat anything.
amharic_ref: ይህን መድሃኒት ከእንቅልፎ እንደነቁ ምንም ሳይበሉ ይውሰዱት።
oromo_ref: Yeroo hirribaa kaatu, waan tokko osoo hin nyaatin dura qoricha kana fudhadhu.

english: If you feel dizzy, sit down and rest.
amharic_ref: የማዞር ስሜት ከተሰማዎት ቁጭ ይበሉ እና ይረፉ።
oromo_ref: Yoo sitti naanna'e, taa'iitii boqodhu.

english: If you have a headache, take one dose.
amharic_ref: ራስ ምታት ካሎት አንድ ዶዝ ይውሰዱ።
oromo_ref: Yoo mataan si dhukkube, safartuu tokko fudhadhu.

english: If the bleeding does not stop, go to the hospital.
amharic_ref: የደም መፍሰሱ ካላቆመ ወደ ሆስፒታል ይሂድ።
oromo_ref: Yoo dhiiguun sun dhaabbachuu dide, gara hospitaalaa deemi.

english: Wait five minutes before using a second type of eye drops.
amharic_ref: ሌላ አይነት የአይን ጠብታዎች ክመጠቀሞ በፊት አምስት ደቂቃዎች ይጠብቁ።
oromo_ref: Gosa coboo ijaa lammaffaa fayyadamuu kee dura daqiiqaa shan eegi.

english: Take this medicine at the same time every day.
amharic_ref: ይህን መድሃኒት በተመሳሳይ ሰዓት በየቀኑ ይውሰዱ።
oromo_ref: Qoricha kana guyyaa hundumaa sa'aatii wal fakkaataatti fudhadhu.

english: Dry the area gently before using the ointment.
amharic_ref: ቅባቱን ከመጠቀሞ በፊት ቦታውን በቀስታ ያድርቁት።
oromo_ref: Dibata sana fayyadamuu kee dura naannoo sana suuta gogsi.

english: Use the spray only when you have trouble breathing.
amharic_ref: መርጫውን የመተንፈስ ችግር ካጋጠሞት ብቻ ይጠቀሙት።
oromo_ref: Yeroo harganuun si rakkisu qofa biiftuu kana fayyadami.

english: Gargle with the mouthwash and spit it out.
amharic_ref: አፍ ማጠቢያውን አፍዎ ውስጥ ይጉመጥመጡና ይትፉት።
oromo_ref: Dhangala'aa afaan ittiin luluqqataniin luluqqadhuutii tufi.

english: Keep the medicine in a cool, dry place.
amharic_ref: መድኃኒቱን በቀዝቃዛና ደረቅ ቦታ ያስቀምጡ።
oromo_ref: Qoricha kana iddoo qabbanaa'aa fi gogaa ta'e kaa'i.

english: Store this medicine in the fridge.
amharic_ref: ይህንን መድኃኒት ማቀዝቀዣ ውስጥ ያስቀምጡ።
oromo_ref: Qoricha kana firiijii keessa kaa'i.

english: Cover the area with a clean bandage after applying the ointment.
amharic_ref: ቅባቱን ከቀቡ በኋላ ቦታውን በንጹህ ጨርቅ ይሸፍኑ።
oromo_ref: Dibata sana erga dibdee booda naannoo sana faashaa qulqulluun haguugi.

english: Use the measuring cup that comes with the bottle.
amharic_ref: ከጠርሙሱ ጋር አብሮ የተሰጠውን መለኪያ ኩባያ ይጠቀሙ።
oromo_ref: Kubbaayyaa safartuu qaruuraa sana waliin dhufu fayyadami.

english: If you forget a dose, skip it and take the next one at the usual time.
amharic_ref: መድኃኒት መውሰድ ከረሱ፣ ያንን በመተው ቀጣዩን መድኃኒት በመደበኛ ሰዓቱ ይውሰዱ።
oromo_ref: Yoo safartuu tokko dagatte, irra darbiitii isa itti aanu sa'aatii baratametti fudhadhu.

english: If your eyes become red or painful, stop using the drops.
amharic_ref: ዓይንዎ ቀይ ከሆነ ወይም ህመም ከተሰማችው ጠብታውን መጠቀም ያቁሙ።
oromo_ref: Yoo ijji kee diimate ykn si dhukkube, coboo sana fayyadamuu dhaabi.

english: Take this medicine after a meal to avoid stomach pain.
amharic_ref: ይህንን መድኃኒት የሆድ ህመም እንዳያመጣብዎ ከምግብ በኋላ ይውሰዱ።
oromo_ref: Dhukkubbii garaachaa ittisuuf qoricha kana nyaata booda fudhadhu.

english: Breathe in slowly while pressing the inhaler.
amharic_ref: ኢንሄለሩን እየተጫኑ በቀስታ ትንፋሽ ይሳቡ።
oromo_ref: Yeroo inheelarii sana dhiibdu suuta gara keessaatti hargani.

english: Take the medicine with water only.
amharic_ref: መድኃኒቱን ከውሃ ጋር ብቻ ይውሰዱ።
oromo_ref: Qoricha kana bishaan qofaan fudhadhu.

english: Give the baby one dropper of the vitamin drops.
amharic_ref: ለህፃኑ ከቪታሚን ጠብታዎች ውስጥ አንድ ጠብታ ይስጡ።
oromo_ref: Daa'imaaf vitaaminii cobtuu tokko kenni.

english: Measure 7.5 ml with the syringe.
amharic_ref: በሲሪንጅ 7.5 ሚሊ ሊትር ለክተዉ ይጠቀሙ።
oromo_ref: Sirinjichaan mililiitira 7.5 safari.

english: Rub a small amount of the lotion onto the rash.
amharic_ref: ሎሽኑን በትንሽ መጠን ሽፍታው ላይ ይቀቡ።
oromo_ref: Loshinii kana xiqqoo madaa gogaa irratti dibuun sukkuumi.

english: Take two tablespoons of the liquid.
amharic_ref: ከፈሳሽ  መድኃኒቱ ሁለት የሾርባ ማንኪያ ይጠቀሙ።
oromo_ref: Dhangala'aa kana fal'aana guddaa lama fudhadhu.

english: Break the tablet in half.
amharic_ref: እንክብሉን ለሁለት ይሰብሩ።
oromo_ref: Kiniinii sana walakkaatti caccabsi.

english: Use a full dropper of the liquid.
amharic_ref: የፈሳሹን ሙሉ ጠብታ ይጠቀሙ።
oromo_ref: Cobtuu dhangala'aa guutuu tokko fayyadami.

english: Use one pump of the lotion.
amharic_ref: ሎሽኑን አንድ ጊዜ በመጫን ይጠቀሙ።
oromo_ref: Loshinii irraa hurguffaa (pampii) tokko fayyadami.

english: Add ten drops of the liquid to a cup of juice.
amharic_ref: ከፈሳሹ ውስጥ 10 ጠብታዎችን ወደ የፍራፍሬ ጭማቂ ጨምሩበት።
oromo_ref: Dhangala'aa irraa coboo kudhan cuunfaa kubbaayyaa tokko keessatti dabaladhu.

english: Take two lozenges.
amharic_ref: ሁለት የሚመጠጡ እንክብሎችን ይውሰዱ።
oromo_ref: Qoricha afaan keessatti baquu (loozinjii) lama fudhadhu.

english: Use a thin strip of cream, about two centimeters long.
amharic_ref: ርዝመቱ ሁለት ሴንቲሜትር ያህል ቀጭን ክሬም በስሱ ይቀቡ።
oromo_ref: Kiriimii kana haphii, dheerina santimeetira lama ta'e dibi.

english: Take one lozenge every two hours.
amharic_ref: በየሁለት ሰዓቱ አንድ የሚመጠጥ እንክብል ይዉሰዱ።
oromo_ref: Sa'aatii lama lamaan loozinjii tokko fudhadhu.

english: Use the inhaler twice a day, morning and evening.
amharic_ref: ኢንሄለሩን በቀን ሁለት ጊዜ (ጠዋትና ማታ) ይጠቀሙ።
oromo_ref: Inheelarii kana ganamaa fi galgala guyyaatti si'a lama fayyadami.

english: Apply the lotion every night for four weeks.
amharic_ref: ሎሽኑን/ቅባቱን ለአራት ሳምንታት በየዕለቱ ማታ ማታ ይቀቡ።
oromo_ref: Torban afuriif galgala galgala loshinii kana dibi.

english: Take two spoonfuls of the syrup every 6 hours.
amharic_ref: ከሽሮፕ መድኃኒቱ ሁለት የሾርባ ማንኪያ በየስድስት ሰዓቱ ይጠጡ።
oromo_ref: Sa'aa 6 6n sirapii kana fal'aana lama lama fudhadhu.

english: Take the medicine once every three days.
amharic_ref: መድኃኒቱን በየሶስት ቀኑ አንድ ጊዜ ይውሰዱ።
oromo_ref: Guyyaa sadii sadii booda al tokko qoricha kana fudhadhu.

english: Use the nasal spray once a day for up to two weeks.
amharic_ref: የአፍንጫ ስፕሬዩን በቀን አንድ ጊዜ ለሁለት ሳምንታት ይጠቀሙ።
oromo_ref: Biiftuu funyaanii kana torban lamaa oliif osoo hin taane guyyaatti si'a tokko fayyadami.

english: Take one vitamin tablet each day for 90 days.
amharic_ref: ለ90 ቀናት በየቀኑ አንድ እንክብል ይውሰዱ።
oromo_ref: Guyyaa 90f guyyaa hundumaa kiniinii vitaaminii tokko fudhadhu.

english: Leave 12 hours between each dose.
amharic_ref: መድኃኒቱን በሚወስዱባቸው ጊዜያት መካከል የ12 ሰዓት ልዩነት መኖር አለበት።
oromo_ref: Fuudha qorichaa tokkoo fi inni itti aanu gidduutti sa'aatii 12 eegi.

english: Do not use this medicine if the packet is open.
amharic_ref: ማሸጊያው የተከፈተ ከሆነ ይህንን መድኃኒት አይጠቀሙ።
oromo_ref: Yoo paakeetiichi banamee jiru ta'e qoricha kana hin fayyadamin.

english: Do not eat or drink for 30 minutes after using this mouthwash.
amharic_ref: ይህንን አፍ ማጠቢያ ከተጠቀሙ በኋላ ለ30 ደቂቃ ምንም ነገር አይብሉ ወይም አይጠጡ።
oromo_ref: Luluqqata afaanii kana erga fayyadamtee booda daqiiqaa 30f waan nyaachuu fi dhuguu irraa oggolaadhu.

english: Do not use this cream on your face.
amharic_ref: ይህን ክሬም ፊቶ ላይ እንዳይጠቀሙት።
oromo_ref: Fuula keetiif kiriimii kana hin fayyadamin.

english: Do not take this medicine if you have had a bad reaction to it before.
amharic_ref: ከዚህ በፊት ለዚህ መድሃኒት መጥፎ ምላሽ ከነበሮት እንዳይወስዱት።
oromo_ref: Yoo duraan qoricha kanaaf miidhaa qabate (alaljii) qabaatte hin fudhatin.

english: Do not use more of this medicine than your doctor told you.
amharic_ref: ሃኪሞ ከነገሮት በላይ ይህን መድሃኒት እንዳይጠቀሙ።
oromo_ref: Hakiimni kee akka si jedheen ol qoricha kana hin fayyadamin.

english: Do not take this medicine in the evening because it may keep you awake.
amharic_ref: ንቁ ሊያደርጎት ስለሚችል ይህን መድሃኒት በምሽት እንዳይወስዱት።
oromo_ref: Hirriba kee waan dhabsiisuuf galgala qoricha kana hin fudhatin.

english: Do not use this ointment on a child under two years.
amharic_ref: ይህን ቅባት ከሁለት ዓመት በታች በሆኑ ልጆች ላይ እንዳይጠቀሙት።
oromo_ref: Daa'ima waggaa lama gadi ta'eef dibata kana hin fayyadamin.

english: Do not drink milk within two hours of taking this medicine.
amharic_ref: ይህን መድሃኒት ከወሰዱ በኋላ ለሁለት ሰዓታት ወተት እንዳይጠጡ።
oromo_ref: Qoricha kana erga fudhattee sa'aatii lama keessatti aanan hin dhugin.

english: Do not leave the bottle open.
amharic_ref: ጠርሙዙን ክፍት እንዳይተዉት።
oromo_ref: Qaruuraa banaatti hin dhiisin.

english: Do not use a kitchen spoon to measure the medicine.
amharic_ref: መድሃኒቱን ለመለካት የጓዳ ማንኪያ እንዳይጠቀሙ።
oromo_ref: Qoricha safaruuf fal'aana mana nyaataa hin fayyadamin.

english: Press the tablet out of the foil just before taking it.
amharic_ref: ኪኒኑን ከመውሰዶ በፊት ከፎይሉ ተጭነው ያሶጡት።
oromo_ref: Osoo hin fudhatin dura battalatti kiniinii sana faayitii irraa baasi.

english: Rinse the syringe with clean water after each use.
amharic_ref: መርፌውን ሁሌ ከተጠቀሙ በኋላ በውሃ ይጠቡት።
oromo_ref: Erga fayyadamtee booda sirinjii bishaan qulqulluun dhiqi.

english: If you have diarrhea, drink plenty of clean water or oral rehydration salts.
amharic_ref: ተቅማጥ ካለቦት ብዙ ውሃ ወይም ኦአሬስ ይጠጡ።
oromo_ref: Yoo garaa kaasaa qabaatte, bishaan qulqulluu baay'ee ykn ashaboo deeggarsa qaamaa (ORS) dhugi.

english: Apply the lotion to dry skin after a bath.
amharic_ref: ሎሽኑን ገላዎን ከታጠቡ በኋላ ደረቅ ቆዳ ላይ ይቀቡት።
oromo_ref: Erga dhiqattee booda loshinii kana gogaa gogoo ta'e irratti dibi.

english: Take this medicine with a snack if it upsets your stomach.
amharic_ref: ለጨጓራዎ ካልተመቾት ይህን መድሃኒት ከቀላል ምግብ ጋር ይውሰዱት።
oromo_ref: Yoo garaachi kee si dhukkube qoricha kana nyaata xiqqoo waliin fudhadhu.

english: If you cannot swallow the tablet, ask a health worker what to do.
amharic_ref: ኪኒኑን መዋጥ ካልቻሉ፤ ምን ማድረግ እንዳለቦት የጤና ባለሙያ ይጠይቁ።
oromo_ref: Yoo kiniinii sana liqimsuu dadhabde, ogeessa fayyaa maal gochuu akka qabdu gaafadhu.

english: If your symptoms do not improve in three days, see a doctor.
amharic_ref: ምልክቶቹ በሶስት ቀናት ውስጥ ካልተሻሻሉ ሃኪም ይዩ።
oromo_ref: Yoo mallattoon kee guyyaa sadii keessatti fooyya'uu baate, doktoora bira deemi.

english: Hold your breath for ten seconds after using the inhaler.
amharic_ref: መተንፈሻውን ከተጠቀሙ በኋላ ትንፋሾን ለአስር ሴኮንዶች ይያዙ።
oromo_ref: Inheelarii fayyadamtee booda sekondii kudhaniif hargansuu kee qabadhu.

english: Close the bottle tightly after each use.
amharic_ref: ሁሌ ጠርሙዙን ከተጠቀሙ በኋላ በደንብ ይዝጉት።
oromo_ref: Erga fayyadamtee booda qaruuraa sana jabeessitii cufi.

english: Open the sachet and pour the powder into a clean glass.
amharic_ref: እሽጉን ከፍተው ዱቄቱን ንጹህ ብርጭቆ ላይ ያፍስሱት።
oromo_ref: Paakeettii sana baniitii daakuu isaa kubbaayyaa qulqulluu keessatti naqi.

english: Tilt your head back and look up when using the eye drops.
amharic_ref: ጭንቅላቶን ወደኋላ አድርገው ወደላይ እያዩ የአይን ጠብታዎቹን ይጠቀሙ።
oromo_ref: Yeroo coboo ijaa fayyadamtu mataa kee gara duubaatti deebisiitii ol ilaali.

english: Check the label before you give the medicine to a child.
amharic_ref: መድሃኒቱን ለልጅ ከመስጠቶ በፊት ጽሁፉን ያረጋግጡ።
oromo_ref: Daa'imaaf qoricha kennuu kee dura lakkoofsa fuula qaruuraa irra jiru ilaali.
